description: Look up UK food banks and what they are asking to have donated, through Give Food's keyless public API. Find the food banks and distribution locations nearest a postcode or address, read any food bank's current shopping list as a list of items, watch the needs published across the country for a particular item, summarise what the food banks near a place want between them, and see the food banks in any parliamentary constituency. Every food bank comes with the constituency it sits in and the MP for it. Give Food keeps the largest public database of the UK's food banks, covering nearly 3,000 locations. No account or API key required.
